purpose: 原721组差分和Proxy访问顺序、逻辑操作量及方法；baseline/临时副本退场，不提供长期执行器。
scope: 形成时验收记录，非当前验证、长期benchmark或可重跑SDK。historicalPath仅标注已退出的现场来源；未保存完整源码镜像、fixture、cache、原始profile。JSON/JSONL按值转存，文本原样保留；sourceSHA256识别补存时读取的原字节，不要求原路径仍存在。

data.timing: not measured; operation counts and exact output comparisons only

registryFixedDepth.note: fixed docs/group/file depth; string hashing/prefix bytes remain

lanes.note: two successful includes scans versus two has scans; set construction separate

observationHistory.note: full final evidence and per-action context/state remain

missingLinkLocation.note: only missing locations incur scanning; code-point cursor advances once in matchAll order

canonicalDeepSingleton.note: nested arrays around 0, chunks join once; recursive stack/key checks remain

topicCounts.note: catalog parsing, validation and full-tree closure unchanged

esmTextConstruction.note: logical strings, not actual rope allocations; quoted token replacement grows by one unit

jsdocSingleSource.note: discovery + per-target reads + final reconstruction read; per-target regex search remains

backtickDelimiter.note: delimiter lengths 3 through 129; this counts searches, not engine-internal character comparisons
